purpose: Prepare the root/ABI cutover so the final compiler root reaches real C providers instead of JS-only exports, with every caller migrated once on the published interfaces. No heavy run is implied by this file.

currentExports.why: no C step config exists in this tree (no c_step_lower); js_emit_step_lower's providerClosure names no c_* module, so c_emit/c_backend*/c_parts cannot enter the root

sourceFileCarrier.constraint: single nominal carrier; the C seam must import BIR.SourceFile and MUST NOT declare a duplicate carrier or copy fields
sourceFileCarrier.note: NativeSeed's gate-native branch files add endpoints; a second carrier in those files would silently split the contract

abiLists.note: root generator emits exactly these wrappers and refuses shadows
hand-written composite driver; must gain the C wrappers with the same names as the root

consumers.note: hosts the JS target today; will need the C start/step entries to drive the C target through the same CLI shape
diagnostic; emitter_request is NOT in the joined composite driver, so this file does not run here as-is — it is test scaffolding, not a caller to migrate
native bridge; consumes BIR.SourceFile paths and bytes
validates the exact root composition prefix and the nine-wrapper order; a C wrapper must be added to both the check and the generated root together
lane selection by declared .c/.js imports; the .c lane becomes honest only when the candidate exposes the C target
proves the library entry without the parser

proposedCInterfaceShape.status: proposal only; FIRAcceptance publishes the real names and types
proposedCInterfaceShape.keep: all ten existing names, signatures and semantics unchanged

add.name: c_modules_start
add.rationale: mirrors emit_modules_start for the C target and reuses the single SourceFile carrier

add.name: c_library_start
add.shape: (program: Checked.CheckedProgram, exports: List<&2, String>, files: List<&2, BIR.SourceFile>) -> CRun<CResult>
add.rationale: only if the C target publishes a library entry; otherwise drop it rather than invent one

add.name: c_step
add.rationale: opaque chunk driver, same quantum discipline as the other three

proposedCInterfaceShape.rootClosureAddition: the C step module plus its provider closure (c_emit, c_backend*, whatever FIRAcceptance's CStep config names), so the root genuinely reaches C providers
proposedCInterfaceShape.callerMigration: abiLists + consumers above, in one cut, with the gate's expected-wrapper list and the root generator updated together

orderingRules: the root embeds accepted parser declarations; any source change after parser acceptance invalidates it, so acceptance comes last in the tree
the gate compares the root composition prefix byte-for-byte including the BIR import line, and requires exactly the ABI-minus-parser wrappers in order; adding C wrappers changes both lists at once
C seam must import BIR.SourceFile rather than declaring a carrier (NativeSeed resume constraint)
openQuestionsForOwners: FIRAcceptance: exact C start/step names, result types, chunk protocol and whether a C library entry exists
FIRAcceptance: whether the C seam needs the reduced checked FIR or the full CheckedProgram as input
NativeSeed: which gate-native branch files add native endpoints, so they are reviewed and integrated rather than duplicated
Main: whether the C wrapper set joins the root's nine (making twelve-ish public names) or ships as a separate component with its own ABI list
